lines.text: In 1908, six cars raced around the world to Paris.

lines.text: They left Times Square in February, with almost no roads ahead.

lines.text: When the roads ran out, they drove on railway tracks, tie to tie, for hundreds of miles.

lines.text: Alaska was so impossible, the race was rerouted by steamer to Japan.

lines.text: But here's the part... the Germans reached Paris first.
They got a thirty day penalty, for skipping Japan and shipping their car part of the way by train.
